 News › News News › Kanpur Holiday 2026: Schools and Government Offices to observe holiday on November 16 for Chhath Puj… Kanpur Holiday 2026: Schools and Government Offices to observe holiday on November 16 for Chhath Puja; December 14 holiday also revised
 Ashita Kashyap Updated: Nov 15, 2026, 10:15 IST Schools and Government Offices to observe holiday on November 16 for Chhath Puja in Kanpur The Kanpur district administration has announced a holiday on November 16, 2026 on the occasion of Chhath Puja. District Magistrate Mahendra Singh Tanwar issued the order on Saturday, November 14.
 The administration has also revised the date of the holiday for Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji's martyrdom day. It will now be observed on December 14 instead of November 24.
 The decision brings changes to the holiday calendar, in Kanpur Nagar. While the November 16 holiday has been announced in place of the scheduled Makar Sankranti holiday, the December holiday has been shifted to a new date.
 Kanpur holiday on November 16 for Chhath Puja 2026 
 The Kanpur district administration has decided that Monday, November 16, 2026 will be a holiday for Chhath Puja. 
 The District Magistrate, Mahendra Singh Tanwar sent out an order to help people celebrate Chhath Puja.
 The order says, all government offices and related places in Kanpur Nagar will stay closed on Monday. This local holiday for Chhath Puja however, has replaced the plan to give a holiday for Makar Sankranti.
 The district administration has also directed the Information Department to make sure that the news about the Chhath Puja holiday reaches everyone through newspapers and other ways of communication.
 Students and parents need to remember that the notice talks about a local holiday for government offices. To know if schools, private colleges or other places will close you must check with those places.
 The order also says that if the state government decides to declare a holiday for Chhath Puja then the district order for the local holiday will no longer be valid.
 Why has Kanpur declared a holiday on November 16? 
 Chhath Puja is one of the major festivals observed in several parts of India, particularly in Bihar, Jharkhand, eastern Uttar Pradesh and some parts of Nepal.
 The festival is dedicated to the worship of the Sun God and Chhathi Maiya. The devotees observe a strict fast and offer prayers to the setting and rising Sun.
 It is a four day festival that includes Nahay Khay, Kharna, Sandhya Arghya and Usha Arghya. The final day involves offering Arghya to the rising Sun, followed by Paran, when devotees break their fast.
 In 2026, Chhath Puja's main rituals fall around November 15 and 16. 
 The morning prayers and completion of the fast on November 16 are among the reasons behind the local holiday announcement.
 The decision is expected to help devotees and their families participate in the festival without the pressure of regular government office work.
 Guru Tegh Bahadur martyrdom day holiday shifted to December 14 
 The Kanpur administration has also revised the holiday date for Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji's martyrdom day.
 Earlier, it was scheduled for November 24, 2026, under the applicable working holiday arrangement. 
 However, it has now been shifted to Monday, December 14, 2026.
 The change follows the Uttar Pradesh government's decision to revise the date of the holiday after considering the Sikh community's request.
 According to reports, representatives of the Sikh community had requested the state government to align the observance with the Nanakshahi calendar. Following this, Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath accepted the request, following which the state government issued a revised order.
 Therefore, December 14 will now be observed as the revised holiday date, while November 24 will no longer be the designated date for this holiday.
 What should students and government employees know? 
 The two announcements are relevant for residents, students and government employees in Kanpur Nagar are as follows:
 November 16, 2026 (Monday): Local holiday in Kanpur Nagar for Chhath Puja, replacing the previously announced Makar Sankranti local holiday.
 November 24, 2026 (Tuesday): Earlier date for the Guru Tegh Bahadur martyrdom day holiday, which has now been revised.
 December 14, 2026 (Monday): Revised holiday date for Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji's martyrdom day.
 It is important for students to check with their schools for confirmation of closures, as a local holiday announcement for government offices does not necessarily apply to every educational institution.
 On the other hand, Government employees should also refer to the official district administration notification for the applicable holiday arrangements.
 The revised calendar highlights two important occasions for Kanpur residents. The Chhath Puja holiday will allow devotees to observe the festival, while the change in the Guru Tegh Bahadur martyrdom day holiday reflects the revised date adopted by the Uttar Pradesh government.
